svg.aria-label: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl, Setup: Hold the bar at shoulder width with your palms down and wrists straight.
svg.title: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl, Setup: Hold the bar at shoulder width with your palms down and wrists straight.

svg.aria-label: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl, Curl: Bend your elbows to lift the bar while keeping your upper arms beside your torso.
svg.title: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl, Curl: Bend your elbows to lift the bar while keeping your upper arms beside your torso.

svg.aria-label: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl, Top: Finish the curl with palms down and wrists in line with your forearms.
svg.title: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl, Top: Finish the curl with palms down and wrists in line with your forearms.

svg.aria-label: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl, Lower: Lower slowly until your arms are long again.
svg.title: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl, Lower: Lower slowly until your arms are long again.
